title: Agentic Test Plan Configuration
description: Extends a signed test plan with an autonomous agentic reasoning loop. Defines how the agent selects actions, tracks state, and when to stop.

enabled.description: Enable the agentic reasoning loop. When false, the session follows a linear pre-planned script.

max_steps.description: Absolute maximum number of atomic actions the agent may take before forced stop.

max_time_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock time in seconds before the agent is halted.

max_duration.description: Alternative stop condition — ISO 8601 duration (e.g. PT1H for 1 hour) converted to internal max_time_seconds.

decision_strategy.description: How the agent selects its next action: 'llm' uses an LLM prompt, 'rule' uses a deterministic rule engine, 'hybrid' uses both with fallback.

llm_prompt.description: System prompt template for the LLM action selector. May reference allowed_tools, authorized_assets, objective via Jinja2-style placeholders.

llm_prompt_template.description: Alias for llm_prompt. Prompt template with variables: {{ allowed_tools }}, {{ authorized_assets }}, {{ objective }}, {{ world_model }}, {{ step }}.

rule_engine_config.description: Configuration for deterministic rule-based strategy (optional). Allows customizing rule phases, priorities, and fallback behavior.

phase_order.description: Custom ordering of exploration phases (e.g. recon, fingerprint, vuln, report)

fallback_on_empty.description: Phase to switch to when the current phase produces no new findings

state_schema.description: JSON Schema defining the structure of the agent's world model state. Tracks discovered assets, vulnerabilities, tested paths.

stop_on_finding.description: Stop immediately when a finding of this severity or higher is confirmed. Can be a single severity or list of severities.

stop_on_criteria_met.description: Stop when all success_criteria from the test plan are satisfied.

stop_conditions.description: Additional stop triggers beyond max_steps and max_time. Each condition defines a type and optional value.

value.description: Parameter for the condition. For finding_severity: severity level. For time_limit: ISO 8601 duration. For max_steps: integer as string. For success_criterion_met: not used.

allow_human_in_the_loop.description: If true, the orchestrator pauses and waits for human approval before each high-impact action (like exploitation).

agent_state_drift_check.description: Enable DRIFT-AGENT-STATE: halt if the agent's world model diverges from confirmed evidence.

evidence_log_reasoning.description: Include the agent's reasoning trace in the evidence log for auditability.

finding_summary.description: Summary of a single security finding discovered by the agent.

title.description: Short description of the finding (e.g. 'Open SSH port on 10.0.0.10').

cve.description: Optional CVE identifier if the finding maps to a known vulnerability.

remediation.description: Optional recommended fix or mitigation step.
